text:
Sara Lopez: Spike in 5xxs on hosted inference since ~09:28 UTC. Customers reporting timeouts and some 502/504s. Dashboard shows error rate ~6% in us-west-2.
devops-bot: ALERT hosted-inference-gateway: 5xx_rate=6.8% window=5m region=us-west-2 -> paging oncall
Mike Chen: I'm looking. Any recent deploys or config changes in the last 3 hours? @Andrea @Lee
Andrea Patel: There was a KV-cache tuning change rolled at 07:55 that reduced connection pool size to the redis cluster. Rolling back that change now to test.
Lee Wong: Logs show a lot of "redis connection timeout" and backpressure in the batcher. When cache drives block, requests fall back to slower path and we hit timeouts upstream.
Jill Ramos: Support queue is getting a handful of angry customers. I'm sending a status to affected accounts and pointing to the status page. :frowning:
Mike Chen: Quick mitigation plan: 1) revert KV-cache pool change 2) scale gateway replicas in us-west-2 by +30% 3) enable fallback http-retries to avoid immediate 5xx surface.
Andrea Patel: Revert done (rolled back to pool_size=128). Monitoring metrics now.
devops-bot: INFO revert-deploy: KV-cache-revert by Andrea Patel at 09:45 UTC
Mike Chen: Scaling gateway now.
Lee Wong: While scaling, enable bypass for cache reads to avoid waiting on redis if timeouts detected. Pushing config flag: `cache.read_fallback=true` to prod-route for a minute.
Andrea Patel: Pushed `cache.read_fallback=true` to route. I'm also increasing redis client timeouts from 200ms -> 500ms as a safety net.
support-bot: NOTE sent status update to customers: "We are experiencing elevated API errors in us-west-2. Mitigations are in progress."
Mike Chen: Error rate dropping to ~1.2% after revert+scale+fallback. 5xx count returning towards baseline.
Jill Ramos: Good — I'm updating the ticket notes and will follow up with customers with ETA for full resolution.
Lee Wong: Short term mitigations look good. Root cause suspects: aggressive pool downsizing + a latent redis replica GC causing transient connection issues.
Sara Lopez: Agree. We'll keep this war room open for 30 more mins to confirm stability, then create a postmortem with action items.
Mike Chen: Action items (creating follow-ups):
- ACTION-1: Roll back pool-size change permanently until we have proper load tests (#INC-4789)
- ACTION-2: Add circuit-breaker for KV cache path and backoff strategy (#INC-4790)
- ACTION-3: Improve redis client observability (pool utilization, per-host latency) (#INC-4791)
- ACTION-4: Update runbook for quick cache bypass and safe scaling steps (#INC-4792)
Andrea Patel: I'll take ACTION-3 and help with instrumentation.
Lee Wong: I'll own ACTION-2 and draft the runbook change for ACTION-4.
Jill Ramos: I'll coordinate customer comms and close affected support tickets after we confirm 1 hour of stable metrics.
Sara Lopez: Thanks team. If error rate stays <1.5% for next hour I'll mark incident mitigated and start postmortem doc. :thumbsup:
Mike Chen: Confirming last check: 5xx=0.9% (5m), tail latency improved. Reverting temporary flags after 1h if stable.
Sara Lopez: Closing war room for active triage. Postmortem owners: Mike (lead), Lee (root cause), Andrea (metrics/instrumentation), Jill (customer comms). Will create postmortem doc in ~2 hours with timeline and impact numbers.
devops-bot: INCIDENT closed (mitigated) by Sara Lopez at 10:32 UTC
